content.text:
Write draft.txt using write_file: a four-sentence public library announcement describing a Saturday repair cafe at 10 a.m. Include the exact phrase 'bring a broken lamp'. Then return a short handoff describing the draft.
Previous completed handoff:
I'll create the draft announcement for you.

input.content: Our public library is excited to announce a Saturday Repair Cafe starting at 10 a.m. this weekend! Join us for a community event where skilled volunteers help you fix household items and learn valuable repair skills. Whether you bring a broken lamp, a malfunctioning toaster, or any other damaged goods, our experts are here to help you restore them. Don't miss this opportunity to save money, reduce waste, and connect with your neighbors in a fun and educational setting.

system: You are the author in a bounded writing workflow. Follow the user's exact file and role instructions. Be concise.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read an inclusive one-based line range; report I/O and range errors.

end_line.description: Last line; default 0 reads through EOF.

max_bytes.description: Maximum retained bytes; defaults to 65536. Omitted content is marked truncated.

path.description: File path, relative to the Agent workspace or absolute; not confined to workspace.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create a file and missing parents. Refuse replacing an existing file without overwrite:true; append mode creates or appends.

append.description: Append or create; default false. When true, overwrite is irrelevant.

content.description: Exact text to write; empty text is valid.

overwrite.description: Allow replacement of existing bytes; default false.

path.description: File path, relative to the Agent workspace or absolute; not confined to workspace.
